lines.377: Standing within, doing what is good for lives, making them saved:
lines.378: so that even the Supreme might seem without care, for many lives
lines.379: standing at the head of heaven, he gives release: our Ramanuja,
lines.380: rising on the face of the earth, made the four saving Vedas grow.
lines.381: By mighty karma that brings growing disease, never finding the courage that rises
lines.382: in greatly good karma, this stinking flesh of a head,
lines.383: holding on and falling until it grows weak, to me who wander alone,
lines.384: there are lords for us: those who have come to Ramanuja.
lines.385: Those whose nature is to reach him and serve: to serve his lasting lotus feet,
lines.386: he reached me today, by his own grace;
lines.387: knowing that none have his nature but those who have reached him,
lines.388: Ramanuja's virtue proclaims those who have reached him.
lines.389: Will he put me in sweet heaven? Will he put me in hell and burn me?
lines.390: Will he plant me again in the whirling ancient births that follow those?
lines.391: Our Ramanuja: will he leave us to ourselves
lines.392: if we say 'Refuge'? O mind, why hesitate to go to him?
lines.393: The quarreling Jains, the Buddhist ghouls, the idle ones who learned
lines.394: the word of the one with the low-hanging locks, the teachers of the void, and the low ones
lines.395: who make mischief so the four Vedas could not stand: they all perished on this wide earth,
lines.396: after our golden wish-granting tree, Ramanuja the sage, came.
lines.397: The golden bee called my heart has come to your flower-feet, wanting
lines.398: to drink the clear honey of bright glory and stay; it is yours:
lines.399: you must give it, O Ramanuja! Other than this, it will take in nothing;
lines.400: from now on, do not show it anything else to confuse it.
lines.401: Tied up in the confusing vine of the two karmas, bewildered,
lines.402: me, born into birth that troubles, removing my sorrow,
lines.403: taking me to be saved, you give, O Ramanuja! That I think of you so,
lines.404: the good say is a fault to those who love you, melting always.
lines.405: My melting mind thinks of your virtues; my tongue stays and calls
lines.406: 'Our lord Ramanuja'; I of hard karma,
lines.407: my hands worship, my eyes long to see; on this sea-girt
lines.408: earth, how has your generosity grown toward me?
lines.409: The growing fierce anger became one lion, and that day it tore
lines.410: the gleaming golden body of the sword-bearing demon: in Ramanuja's mind,
lines.411: where the crop of his fame rises and ripens, he removed my body's disease of karma
lines.412: and gave good wisdom, like a fruit placed in my hand.
lines.413: Even if you showed me Kannan and gave him like a fruit in my hand, other than
lines.414: the glory shining in your body, I want nothing; whether I lie
lines.415: in hell's misery or reach the radiant heaven, if you give this grace,
lines.416: I will bear it, O Ramanuja, my rich rain cloud!
lines.417: The wondrous one who sleeps on the rich-waved ocean of milk: the good wise ones
lines.418: who dwell in the hearts of those who fall beneath his holy feet, the good Vedic ones
lines.419: worship the holy feet of Ramanuja; the place where the great ones who worship him
lines.420: rise, sing, and dance, is my dwelling place, his servant's.
lines.421: His dwelling place is Vaikuntha, Venkatam, and the mountain called Malirunjolai,
lines.422: say the good, for the wonder; together with them, he came
lines.423: to dwell in the mind of Ramanuja; today, that one came
lines.424: to dwell within my heart, for his own joy.
lines.425: O Ramanuja of joyful goodness, always, everywhere,
lines.426: even if I am born in body after body with disease in my bones, and die,
lines.427: suffering beyond count, there is one thing I ask: make me
lines.428: one who stays in love with your devotees, and make me their servant there.
lines.429: The lady of the great lotus who dwells on the lovely chest of the Lord of southern Arangam,
lines.430: whose fields are leapt by lovely fish: let us praise her, so that all devotion
lines.431: may abide and flourish, O heart, upon our heads,
lines.432: the flower-feet of Ramanuja of swelling fame.
